# barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_role_override (Resource)

Manages an LLM Gateway API key lifetime **role override**: the policy for users with one IdP role, replacing the organization default for them. Role overrides count alongside group overrides. Requires a platform that serves role overrides (API version 2.39.0 or later).

The policy limits how long API keys that users create for themselves (self-serve, from their own settings) may live. Keys created by admins are exempt. Existing keys keep their expiry: the policy is checked when a key is created or rotated.

Which policy applies to a user: their own `barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_user_override` if they have one; otherwise the strictest of their groups' `barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_group_override`s and their IdP roles' `barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_role_override`s, taken together (the shortest maximum, and an expiry required if any requires one); otherwise the organization default (`barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_policy`). An override replaces what it overrides, so it can be longer or shorter, and one with no limits set exempts its group, role or user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Interns' self-serve keys get exactly a week; they don't choose.
resource "barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_role_override" "intern" {
  role_name         = "intern"
  max_lifetime_days = 7
  fixed_lifetime    = true
}

# An override with no limits exempts the role from the default.
resource "barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_role_override" "admin" {
  role_name = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_name` (String) IdP role whose holders this override applies to: a role synced from the identity provider, the same kind Model Access matches, not the platform admin role. The platform allows one override per role and answers 409 on a second. Changing it forces a new override.

### Optional

- `fixed_lifetime` (Boolean) Every key gets exactly `max_lifetime_days`, and users don't choose an expiry. Requires `max_lifetime_days`. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_lifetime_days` (Number) Longest a key may live, in days from when it is created or rotated (1-3650). A maximum also rules out keys that never expire. The platform allows a day of slack, so "the end of the last allowed day" fits in any time zone. Omit for no maximum.
- `require_expiry` (Boolean) Keys must have an expiry, even without a maximum. Implied by `max_lifetime_days`. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Override UUID assigned by the API; also the `terraform import` key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by override UUID.
terraform import barndoor_llm_api_key_lifetime_role_override.intern 5c2d7e1f-8a9b-4c3d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
```
